mapper.select: SELECT stu_id AS stuId, stu_name AS stuName FROM t_mst_student WHERE del_flg = 0 ORDER BY stu_name
SELECT DISTINCT subject_id AS subjectId, subject_name AS subjectName FROM v_latest_subject_info_from_student_document WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} ORDER BY subject_id

SELECT stu_id AS stuId, subject_id AS subjectId, subject_sub_id AS currentSubjectSubId, subject_sub_name AS currentSubjectSubName, lesson_fee AS currentLessonFee, lesson_fee_adjusted AS currentLessonFeeAdjusted, pay_style AS payStyle, minutes_per_lsn AS minutesPerLsn, year_lsn_cnt AS yearLsnCnt FROM v_latest_subject_info_from_student_document WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} AND subject_id = #{subjectId}

SELECT subject_sub_id AS subjectSubId, subject_sub_name AS subjectSubName, subject_price AS subjectPrice FROM t_info_subject_edaban WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND del_flg = 0 AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(subject_sub_id, '[^0-9]', '') AS UNSIGNED) >= CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{currentSubjectSubId}, '[^0-9]', '') AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(subject_sub_id, '[^0-9]', '') AS UNSIGNED)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_info_student_document ( stu_id, subject_id, subject_sub_id, adjusted_date, pay_style, minutes_per_lsn, lesson_fee, lesson_fee_adjusted, year_lsn_cnt ) VALUES ( #{doc.stuId}, #{doc.subjectId}, #{doc.newSubjectSubId}, #{doc.adjustedDate}, #{doc.payStyle}, #{doc.minutesPerLsn}, #{doc.newLessonFee}, #{doc.newLessonFeeAdjusted}, #{doc.yearLsnCnt} )
mapper.select: SELECT fee.lsn_fee_id AS lsnFeeId, fee.lesson_id AS lessonId, lsn.lesson_type AS lessonType, fee.lsn_fee AS lsnFee, fee.lsn_month AS lsnMonth FROM t_info_lesson_fee fee INNER JOIN t_info_lesson lsn ON fee.lesson_id = lsn.lesson_id WHERE lsn.stu_id = #{stuId} AND lsn.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND fee.lsn_month >= #{startYearMonth} AND fee.own_flg = 0 AND fee.del_flg = 0 ORDER BY fee.lsn_month, fee.lsn_fee_id, fee.lesson_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_info_lesson SET subject_sub_id = #{newSubjectSubId}, update_date = NOW() WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId}
